name: pillar-wide
note: Room 5.19's breakable pillar: the game draws it into a 640x480 target of its own and lays that picture over the frame lit green. Since 1.8.10 the 3D drawn into such a target was left at the console's 4:3 and its picture squeezed over the frame to match (enemies' after-images), so as the camera turned the pillar was cut at the 4:3 edge, past it only its light shaft. Now a target whose picture was laid over the whole frame takes its 3D at the screen's shape the frames after, and the picture is laid over as it is (telemetry wide.apart: such pictures laid over wide, and squeezed: the first frame only).
